title: Track 4 - Consequence-aware IDS audit: which detector do you deploy?
summary: A stealthy ramp-drift attack on real traffic. You choose the detector BEFORE the attack; its measured behaviour (9-fold, group-held-out benchmark) decides the physical outcome.

nodes.title: Choose the detector
nodes.narration: Same real traffic, same attack (the claimed position drifts at 0.5 m/s up to 15 m from t=8.0 s); only the deployed IDS differs. Alert times are the measured ones from the held-out evaluation, shown for a representative case chosen by a fixed rule (see scenarios/README.md).

defender.text: Candidates: Isolation Forest, Random Forest, RF + physics residual features, physics verifier.

options.label: Isolation Forest (benign-only training)
options.feedback: IF never alerted on this drift.

options.label: Random Forest (supervised)
options.feedback: RF never alerted on this drift.

options.label: RF + physics-residual features
options.feedback: Physics features close most of the gap.

options.label: Physics verifier (v = v0 + a dt, dx = v dt, gap cross-check)
options.feedback: Alerts on inconsistency itself, even when features look benign.

nodes.title: Outcome: Isolation Forest
nodes.narration: No alert; the drift grows to 15 m.

nodes.title: Outcome: Random Forest
nodes.narration: No alert; the drift grows to 15 m.

nodes.title: Outcome: RF + physics features
nodes.narration: Alert shortly after the attack begins.

nodes.title: Outcome: physics verifier
nodes.narration: Alert once the accumulated drift violates the kinematic identities.
